parts.gloss: those who do not love in return

words.gloss: those who do not love us

literal: O heart! Saying that they disliked us, is there abandoning them, when they are those who do not love us even if we love them?
translation: O my heart! Is it possible for us to abandon him saying 'he dislikes us', when he is one who does not love us even when we love him?
modern: நெஞ்சே! நாம் அன்பு செய்தாலும் நம்மிடம் அன்பு செய்யாதவராகிய அவரை, 'அவர் நம்மை வெறுத்துவிட்டார்' என்று கூறி நம்மால் கைவிட முடியுமா?
explanation: In this couplet, the heroine speaks to her own heart about her inability to let go of her lover. She asks her heart if they can truly abandon him under the excuse that he dislikes or is angry with them (செற்றார்). She points out the bitter truth: he is already someone who does not return their love (உறாஅதவர்) even when they love him deeply (யாம் உற்றால்). Since they could not stop loving him despite his indifference, they cannot easily cast him aside now just because of his apparent hostility.
